parameters.name: FileSystemMountEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether file storage mounting is supported.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The default image ID of the node group. If this parameter is not specified, the image remains unchanged.

parameters.name: LoginPassword
parameters.description: The logon password of the machines in the node group.

parameters.name: RamRoleName
parameters.description:
The RAM role name of the node. You can call the RAM API ListRoles to query the node RAM roles that you have created. The trusted entity of the role must be set to Lingjun AI Computing Service.
<warning>If you set this parameter to an empty string (""), the RAM role of the node group is cleared.</warning>

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom executable shell script. The script must be Base64-encoded. The maximum size of the raw data is 16 KB.
